other_failure_modes.name: Pipeline used instead of ColumnTransformer
other_failure_modes.description: The agent mistakenly uses `sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline` to group column-specific transformations instead of `sklearn.compose.ColumnTransformer` (despite importing the latter). This causes the pipeline to run sequentially on all columns, passing categorical strings into numerical imputers and scalers, resulting in a fatal ValueError.

summary: The agent attempts a straightforward regression using LightGBM but makes a critical coding error by using `Pipeline` instead of `ColumnTransformer` for feature preprocessing, which causes a fatal execution crash. Furthermore, the agent fails to implement any validation strategy (training directly on the full dataset and predicting on the test set) and bypasses feature engineering completely.
